name: tr_scottie
caption:
IF SCOTTIE HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🥊 Riolu: a hard worker, but still just a youngster. Rookie of the Year in year one
🔵 Lucario: reads the thoughts and movements of everyone around it. Reads the whole floor, 5.1 assists a night
❄️ Weavile: its ability is literally called Pickpocket. 2.3 steals a game
⭐ Garchomp: flies as fast as a jet, never lets its prey escape. All-Star in 2024 and 2026
🔥 Incineroar: when its fighting spirit is lit, its flames burn hotter. 41 points on 19-of-34 this season
🦖 Tyrantrum: the king of the ancient world. Our raptor, 23.5 points a night

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: And the ace. Tyrantrum. The king of the ancient world. Our raptor, twenty-three point five a night.
